meta.name: prisma-mongodb-upgrade
meta.description: Decision and migration guide for Prisma ORM MongoDB projects on v6, which have no upgrade path to v7. Use when a MongoDB project asks about upgrading Prisma, when "upgrade to prisma 7" comes up in a project with provider = "mongodb", or when evaluating a move to Prisma Next. Triggers on "upgrade prisma mongodb", "prisma 7 mongodb", "mongodb prisma migration", "prisma next mongodb".

copy.tagline: 规划 MongoDB 项目在 Prisma 升级受阻时的迁移路径
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的 MongoDB 项目 Prisma 停在 v6,升级无路。
copy.tagline_en: Chart a migration path for MongoDB projects stuck on Prisma v6
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a MongoDB project on Prisma v6 and need a way to move forward.

howto.what: 装好后,你在 MongoDB 项目里问 Prisma 升级时,Claude 会说明 MongoDB 没有 Prisma 7 连接器,并给出「留在 v6 还是迁到 Prisma Next」的决策指引和迁移步骤。
howto.when: 当使用 provider = "mongodb" 的项目询问升级 Prisma、提到「upgrade to prisma 7」,或评估迁到 Prisma Next 时触发。

say.note: 按事务等阻塞项给出方向

howto.what_en: When you ask about Prisma upgrades in a MongoDB project, Claude explains that MongoDB has no Prisma 7 connector and gives a decision plus migration steps: stay on v6 or move to Prisma Next.
howto.when_en: Use when a project with provider = "mongodb" asks about upgrading Prisma, mentions "upgrade to prisma 7", or evaluates a move to Prisma Next.

say_en.text: Can my Prisma MongoDB project upgrade to v7?
say_en.note: Explains v7 has no MongoDB connector

say_en.text: Should I stay on v6 or migrate to Prisma Next?
say_en.note: Gives a direction based on blockers
